messages:
Olivia (sales): Hey team — NovaBank POC is blocked pending compliance artifacts. They asked for SOC 2 attestation, a pen-test letter, and a short list of ISO compliance statements. Need this by next Wed 03/31. Can org/security confirm what we can share and timelines?
Mike (AE): +1. Also customer asked if Dedicated pricing includes SOC-related support or if that's an add-on.
Sam (SE): I can assemble a redacted evidence pack (config screenshots, network diagram, data flow). Quick Q — do we have a canonical list they expect, or should I send our standard "evidence checklist"?
Jordan (Security): We can provide the SOC 2 Type II report summary and a pen-test confirmation letter. Full SOC report requires an NDA and usually a signed MoU. Pen-test letter: we provide a one-page summary signed by security stating third-party test performed, date, scope, and no high findings (redacted details).
Rita (Legal): Confirming: share SOC summary via our secure portal after NDA executed. We should not share raw logs or vuln reports. Pen-test letter is fine as long as it contains no exploitable details. Need to route through legal for signature.
Carlos (Customer): To clarify — the bank needs the SOC 2 cover page + auditor name, date range, and the pen-test letter for procurement. They also asked for evidence of encryption at rest and KMS integration (short statement).
Sam (SE): Got it. Draft checklist I'll prepare:
```
- SOC 2 attestation (cover page + auditor + date range)
- Penetration test summary letter (third-party, date, scope)
- Encryption at rest statement + KMS vendor (high level)
- Network diagram (redacted IPs)
- Data retention & deletion statement
- Contact for follow-up (security@redwood.com)
```
Jordan (Security): Timeline: I can draft pen-test letter today, Rita can sign tomorrow. Sam — can you compile the network diagram + KMS blurb by EOD tomorrow?
Sam (SE): Yes, will do. Also note: POC uses hosted models — customer asked if Dedicated gives isolated logs for audit. That's a pricing/ops question.
Mike (AE): On pricing — Dedicated includes isolated compute and tenant-level access controls. Logging retention/export features are add-ons on enterprise tier. I'll flag pricing amendment in the quote.
Olivia (sales): Awesome. Can someone confirm whether we need to run another internal pentest for this POC scope or if our latest third-party (2025-11-09) covers it? Customer wants recent test within 12 months.
Jordan (Security): Our last third-party was 2025-11-09. It's within 12 months for them now, but if procurement insists on "within 6 months" we can provide an internal scoped review note.
Rita (Legal): I'll prepare a short NDA template for SOC report exchange and add an exhibit limiting use to procurement review.
CSM-Bot: Reminder set — follow-up with customer on 1795123600 (tomorrow 10:00 PT).
Mike (AE): Can Carlos confirm preferred delivery method (secure portal link vs email with SFTP)?
Carlos (Customer): Portal preferred. Procurement will need a link they can access after NDA.
Olivia (sales): Action items: Sam assemble pack + network diagram (EOD tomorrow). Jordan draft pen-test letter (today). Rita prepare NDA (tomorrow morning). Mike update quote re: Dedicated logging add-on. I'll coordinate delivery to procurement after NDA is signed.
Sam (SE): I'll upload artifacts to our secure portal draft folder and ping once ready.
Jordan (Security): Drafting letter now, will post here for review before signature.
Rita (Legal): Once draft is posted tag me, I'll review and sign.
Olivia (sales): Thanks team :thumbsup: — keeping this thread as the single source of truth.
Carlos (Customer): Thanks, looking forward to the portal link.
